item.title: Assessing Iraola's Liverpool start
item.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola asked for judgements on his tenure to wait until after the November international break - we assess how the Basque is faring so far in his new role ahead of the visit of Manchester United in the Premier League on Super Sunday.

item.title: How 'sleeping giant' Everton are exceeding expectations
item.description: Everything felt a bit gloomy at Everton after the closure of the summer transfer window. 'Disappointment' was the buzzword used by David Moyes - especially after a Deadline Day move for Folarin Balogun fell through.

item.title: Seven years on from the sack at Spurs what sort of coach is Pochettino now?
item.description: What Mauricio Pochettino achieved with Tottenham Hotspur in the previous decade looks even more impressive now than it did at the time. Manchester United really should have turned to the popular Argentine coach years ago.

item.title: Man City have problems - is Fernandez their most obvious?
item.description: Enzo Maresca is being forced to work within an unprecedented set of circumstances this season. Up until recently, his fixation on football matters served to quieten the noise around the club. But now the anomalous nature of Manchester City's situation is apparent on and off the pitch.

item.title: Mercedes set to run ADUO engine upgrade in Las Vegas with one driver
item.description: World champions Mercedes will bring their ADUO turbocharger upgrade to this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, although George Russell will not use it to avoid having to take another grid penalty in his bid for second place in the Drivers' Championship.
